ambiguities.source_text: Create a field which shows how much money will be lost for each item
ambiguities.intent: Multiply the inventory Unit Price by inventory Quantity, then sum before rounding.

ambiguities.source_text: Create a new field that identifies stores as High Priority (lost £5000 or more) or Low Priority (below £5000)
ambiguities.ref: out2["Issue Level"] = out2["Total Price Rounded"].apply(lambda v: "High Priority" if v >= 5000 else "Low Priority")
ambiguities.intent: Use the rounded store total: at least 5000 is High Priority, otherwise Low Priority.
